run_main: run the main function to demonstrate using a CLI token with the LiteLLM SDK
get_gateway_api_key: retrieve the CLI authentication token stored locally after running litellm-proxy login
list_valid_models: list all available models on the LiteLLM proxy server using the CLI token
send_completion_request: send a completion request to the LiteLLM proxy using the CLI token and a model
review_main: review the main function that demonstrates CLI token authentication with the LiteLLM proxy
